contentList.content: Affected entity has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>. It must run from the source of its fear, and can't take any additional actions.

The affected entity must move away from the creature that Turned it.

It can't take actions, bonus actions, or reactions other than Dash, or try to escape an effect that prevents movement.

Ends upon taking damage.
Deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag>.

Takes [1] at the start of each turn and has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

Removed by healing.
Attacks against this creature deal an additional [1]. Removed by healing.

Cannot move. <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against the affected entity have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>, while its Attack Rolls have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>. It also has Disadvantage on Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Affected entity can't move. <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against it have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.

Cannot move. Frightened entities also have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.
Can't attack spellcaster. Spellcaster has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> in dialogue.

Affected entity's brain is cooking in a stew of hot blood.

It has Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks and Saving Throws, and behaves as if Befuddled during combat.
Affected entity has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRolls">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.

Beaded and adrip with thick oily sweat, the affected entity has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> using Strength.

Rotting in their own vat of stinking skin, the affected entity has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerability</LSTag> to all damage.

Affected entity oozes waxy, globulous blood. It has Disadvantage on Constitution Checks and Saving Throws.

In addition, whenever it takes damage, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
Suffers <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>.
Has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, and <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> is reduced by 1.

Affected entity has its <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> reduced by 1, and has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Involuntary convulsions shiver through the affected entity, giving it <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> using Dexterity.

The affected entity has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Checks, and Attack Rolls against it have Advantage.

Removed by taking damage or when Helped.
Affected entity is utterly enamelled in ice. It becomes <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INCAPACITATED">incapacitated</LSTag> and vulnerable to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage.
